question: Who became the new Chief Minister of Uttarakhand after elections in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pushkar Singh Dhami.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pushkar Singh Dhami was elected as the new Chief Minister of Uttarakhand in July 2021, not in February 2022 as mentioned in the question.**
 
• Dhami succeeded **Tirath Singh Rawat **as the Chief Minister of Uttarakhand.
 
• Dhami is a member of the** Bharatiya Janata Party** (BJP) and represents the **Khatima constituency** in the Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly.
 
• He has previously served as the** Leader of Opposition **in the Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jai Ram Thakur is the current Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh.**

 
 
• He was chosen to serve in the Himachal Pradesh Legislative Assembly from the Mandi district's Seraj Assembly constituency. 
 
 
 
• **Bhupendra Rajnikant Patel is the current Chief Minister of Gujarat.**
 
 
• Since 2017, he has served as the Gujarat Legislative Assembly's representative for the Ghatlodia Assembly constituency.
 
 
 
• **Pramod Sawant is the current Chief Minister of Goa.**
 
 
• He has been a Bharatiya Janata Party member representing the **Sanquelim constituency** in the Goa Legislative Assembly since 2012.
